fixes.explanation: Mighty sounds like it could fit, but the psalm doesn't say it. It says, "The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground." Strength is something the psalm talks about a few verses later, when it says He "does not delight in the strength of the horse" (Psalm 147:10). So the ones He holds up aren't the ones leaning on their own power. They're the humble.

Clever is a fine thing to be. But the verse doesn't say it. It says, "The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground." The psalm also says His understanding "has no limit" (Psalm 147:5), so the ones He sustains aren't the ones who think they've got it all figured out. The humble know they need Him, and He holds them up.
